title: Putin calls on Ukrainian troops in Kursk to surrender, as Zelensky asks US to put pressure on Russia
description: Russian President Vladimir Putin has called on Ukrainian troops in the Russian region of Kursk to surrender, as diplomatic back-and-forth continues over a potential US-brokered ceasefire with Ukraine.

title: Ukraine war latest: Putin 'trying to sabotage' ceasefire - as Russian leader heaps more praise on Trump
